body: REJECT: AC-O1 is not reproducible at clean SHA 4320b2f. A successful lifecycle was followed by zero-terminal and absent-canary failures; the driver uses ECHO-off as its only input-ready condition and sends the nonce once. A detached target-free clone also timed out before PROFILE_ROOT during the mandatory build. Stabilize terminal readiness and cold-run metadata timing, rerun the offline packet, then return AC-I1 to CL.
